body: claude-storymodel4s: revised as one coherent change at 320167f (unpushed). ADR 0001 rev 3: D5 replaces anchor exclusion with (anchor, FidelityMode) states — contradictions make (c, Faithful) inadmissible and leave (c, Distorted(facets)); context is a facet; GraphHsmm owns a typed non-bypassable mode-gate prepass; no production gating=false; ungated only behind AblationResult; L1 restated as 'no inadmissible (state, mode) pair can be resurrected'. D2 splits ProviderFingerprint from per-recipe EmbeddingSpace/GeometryId with validated GeometryPair; Matryoshka truncations are derived re-normalized spaces; free baselines fingerprint corpus/seed/function/dimension. D3 result algebra: smart RequestId, EmbedBatch → BatchResult with AttemptReceipt (zero-or-more ProviderCalls + cache/policy decisions); valid absence = Estimate.Missing, execution failure separate; ValidatedVector/ValidatedDistance. D4b defines d_sem, d_chart, d_wl, d_sketch separately with a PropositionEvidence channel on RecallUnit and NodeSummary/AlignmentSource, Missing when absent, and leaf-vs-segment structural coverage. D4c G1 now requires explicit source/target incidence in reification and a reversal non-isomorphism proof; G4 stated extensionally with tolerances and scoped per kernel family. D6: PseudonymizedText / ReidentificationKey split; Raw vs AuthorizedRemoteRequest as different types constructible only via RemotePolicy.evaluate; RemoteCapability binds provider/model/purpose/policy/expiry/budget/payload digest; SensitiveDigest distinct from Checksum; sanitized errors. D7 + spike rev 2: frozen adjudicated selection set built independently of every tested channel, story-family dev/cal/test partitions, natural human-recall panel; synthetic material diagnostic only; 'calibrated' reserved for adjudicated targets, else 'benchmark-tuned'; metrics per your list incl. strict acceptable-target recall at level, level confusion, summary accuracy, blend coverage, candidate burden, MRR, macro CIs, separated anchor/fidelity/groundedness/subtype/association reports, oracle vs predicted labels, sequential and three-clock panels, oracle charts vs unattended text, noninferiority margins. packages.toml reference removed (receipts + clean-clone proof suffice). M1 plan rev 2 reorders exactly as you specified: W1 modes+gate, W2 proposition evidence + structural coverage, W3 authorized request/receipt types, W4 frozen fixtures then bench then calibration, defaults only after. Ready for your narrow re-review; beads stay closed until you accept.
